select_ctrls.tip: Select every animation controller of the rig.
select_ctrls.what: Finds the rig node (SID) in the scene and selects all its animation controllers, ready to key, copy or clear.
steps: Key, copy or clear what is selected.
examples: Click it, then press S to key the whole rig on the current frame.
Click it before Copy Anim to copy the animation of the whole character.
Select everything, then Clear Keys to reset only what the SID knows about.
Select them, then Save Anim to Desktop to keep a pose library.
select_ctrls.details: Calls animation_utils.select_ctrls_from_sid(): reads the controllers listed on the rig SID node, so ctrls not tagged on the SID are not picked. If nothing gets selected, check the SID exists (AssetsRigger > Create Rig Sid).

load_anim.tip: Load the animation picked in the list onto the rig.
load_anim.what: Loads the Studio Library animation chosen in the paths list onto the rig controllers.
steps: Pick an animation in the paths list.
examples: Pick a walk cycle in the list, click Load Anim to see the rig walk.
Use it to test a new rig with a known animation before sending it.
Load the same ROM on every new version of a rig to compare deformation.
Load a walk on two rig versions side by side to spot skin changes.
load_anim.details: studio_library_utils.load_rom(path) loads a Studio Library .anim onto the scene objects by name. Ctrls missing in the rig are skipped silently, so renamed ctrls simply get no keys.

prev_key.tip: Go to the previous key and frame the selection.
prev_key.what: Jumps the time slider to the previous key of the selected objects and frames them in the viewport.
examples: Select a hand ctrl, click << to step back through its keys.
Use it with the Rotate 90 test to walk a joint through its keys.
Step back to the frame where a joint popped to find the bad key.

next_key.tip: Go to the next key and frame the selection.
next_key.what: Jumps the time slider to the next key of the selected objects and frames them in the viewport.
examples: Select a hand ctrl, click >> to step forward through its keys.
Check every pose of a ROM one by one on the selected ctrl.
Walk the ROM key by key while painting weights.

next_key_2.what: Jumps the time slider to the next key of the selected objects, the camera does not move.
examples: Step through a ROM pose by pose without the view jumping around.
Step keys while you keep the camera framed on the face.

GlobalTester.tip: Key test moves on the Global controller.
GlobalTester.what: Adds a quick animation to the Global ctrl (move, rotate, scale) to check that the whole rig follows.
steps: Look for anything left behind: geo, ctrls, constraints.
examples: Click it, play the timeline: everything should move and scale together, skin included.
Find a mesh that is not under the rig scale: it stays put while the rest scales.
Check a prop rig scales with its Global ctrl before publishing.
GlobalTester.details: animation_utils.global_ctrl_movements() keys translate / rotate / scale on the Global ctrl. Anything not inheriting from it (world space constraints, unparented geo, deltaMush without the rig scale connected) shows up as left behind.

Rotate90.tip: Key a 90 degree rotation test on the selection.
Rotate90.what: Keys the selected controllers rotating 90 degrees, a fast way to check deformation.
examples: Select the elbow FK ctrl, click it, play to see how the arm bends.
Select all finger FK ctrls and test the knuckles in one go.
Test the spine twist: select the chest ctrl and click it.
Rotate90.details: animation_utils.create_rotate_nighty() keys the selection rotating 90 degrees. Clear Keys afterwards.

copy_anim.tip: Copy the animation of the selected controllers.
copy_anim.what: Saves the animation of the selection to a temporary file so you can paste it on another rig or scene.
steps: Select the same ctrls on the other rig and Paste Anim.
examples: Select the ctrls of rig A, Copy Anim, open rig B, select the same ctrls, Paste Anim.
Copy a test animation before a rebuild, paste it after to compare.
copy_anim.details: Saves a baked Studio Library .anim of the selection to the tool temp folder (AnimLoaderCopy.anim, replaced every time). Paste matches by node name.

paste_anim.tip: Paste the copied animation on the selection.
paste_anim.what: Loads the animation saved with Copy Anim onto the selected controllers (matched by name).
examples: After a rebuild, paste back the test animation you copied before.
Paste the same animation onto a copy of the rig.
Paste a facial test on the new face install.
paste_anim.details: Loads AnimLoaderCopy.anim from the temp folder onto the selection by name. Nothing copied yet means nothing to paste.

save_anim_to_desktop.tip: Save the selection animation to the desktop.
save_anim_to_desktop.what: Asks for a name and saves the animation of the selected controllers to your desktop.
steps: Click it and type a name.
examples: Save "walk_test" to share it with a teammate or keep it between sessions.
Save a stress pose the animators reported, to test fixes against it.
save_anim_to_desktop.details: Saves a baked .anim to ~/Desktop/AnimLoader/<name>.anim with studio_library_utils.save_rom.

load_anim_from_desktop.tip: Load an animation saved on the desktop.
load_anim_from_desktop.what: Asks for the name you used in Save Anim to Desktop and loads it on the selection.
steps: Click it and type the saved name.
examples: Type "walk_test" to load the walk you saved earlier.
Load the reported stress pose after each skin fix.

clear.tip: Delete all keys and reset the rig.
clear.what: Removes the keys of the rig controllers and sets them back to their default pose.
examples: Click it after testing to give the rig back clean, with no animation.
Clean a rig after a test session before saving it.
clear.details: studio_library_utils.delete_keys(), then resets some extra attrs by name (legacy master_2_sub_ctrl / legIK autoStrech and the Hip switch bend attrs). Missing attrs only print a warning.

load_mocap.tip: Load the chosen Mixamo mocap on the rig.
load_mocap.what: Retargets the Mixamo animation picked in the list onto the Mutant rig.
steps: Pick a Mixamo clip in the list.
examples: Pick "Running", click Load Mocap to see the rig run.
Use Restore Mutant Rig afterwards to go back to the normal rig.
Check shoulders and knees on fast motion like a jump.
Show a client the rig moving with a mocap run cycle.
load_mocap.details: retarget.Retarget().load_mixamo_animation() builds a temporary retarget setup from the Mixamo skeleton to the Mutant ctrls. Restore Mutant Rig removes it.

restore_mutant_rig.tip: Undo the mocap setup and restore the rig.
restore_mutant_rig.what: Removes the retarget setup made by Load Mocap and gives you the normal rig back.
examples: After checking a mocap clip, click it before you keep working on the rig.
Restore before saving so the retarget nodes do not get published.
restore_mutant_rig.details: retarget.Retarget().restore_scene(): deletes the retarget nodes and gives the ctrls back.

create_rom.tip: Create the range of motion animation.
create_rom.what: Keys a ROM (range of motion) on the rig: every part moves through its range so you can check skinning.
examples: Click Run, scrub the timeline and look for bad deformations.
Run it after every big skin change.
create_rom.details: calisthenics_utils.create_rom() keys a fixed set of body poses on the Mutant ctrls by name.

clean_rom.tip: Remove the range of motion keys.
clean_rom.what: Deletes the ROM created by Run and puts the rig back to its default pose.
examples: Click Clean before saving the rig file.
Clean, then save: published rigs should have no keys.
clean_rom.details: calisthenics_utils.clean_rom(): removes the ROM keys and zeroes the ctrls.

run_import.tip: Open a new scene, import the published rig and run the ROM.
run_import.what: Starts a new scene, imports the latest published rig version and creates the ROM on it.
steps: Make sure the rig is published.
Check the ROM on the published rig.
examples: Check the published rig, not your work file, with one click.
Check the publish did not lose the skin of a prop.
run_import.details: New scene (unsaved changes are lost), imports the latest pipeline publish of the rig, then create_rom(). Needs the studio pipeline (star).
